sources.title: 2025 property-tax rates
sources.description: Town, school, county, and precinct rates, plus an explanation of how property taxes are calculated.

sources.title: Town agendas & minutes
sources.description: Meeting listings for the Select Board, Budget Committee, and other boards. Linked meeting documents are not yet fully archived.

sources.title: 2026 budgets & town meeting
sources.description: Official entry point for proposed budgets, warrant articles, election results, and tax-impact calculators.

sources.title: Town procurement opportunities
sources.description: Published bids for goods, services, and public works. A bid notice is not evidence of a contract award or payment.

sources.title: Town purchasing policy
sources.description: Published procurement requirements and exceptions. Confirm the policy effective on the date of any purchase.

sources.title: Municipal Budget Committee
sources.description: Budget Committee information and links to budget documents, warrants, and meeting materials.

sources.title: Hampton School District meetings
sources.description: Official school board meeting information. External documents and embedded portals may require following the source links.

sources.title: Winnacunnet budget resources
sources.description: SAU 21 budget presentations and summaries, including Winnacunnet. The page also contains other school districts.

sources.title: Winnacunnet School Board records
sources.description: Official gateway to school board agendas, minutes, videos, and policies in BoardDocs.

requests.title: General ledger & account map
requests.description: Existing electronic ledger exports and chart of accounts for completed fiscal years, with funds, departments, account codes, dates, and transaction references.

requests.title: Payments & vendor register
requests.description: Existing accounts-payable payment records, including reversals and voids. Exclude bank details, tax identifiers, and protected personal information.

requests.title: Contracts & purchase orders
requests.description: Contract register, amendments, purchase orders, procurement justifications, and supporting invoices for selected projects.

requests.title: Budget changes & reconciliation
requests.description: Adopted and amended budgets, monthly financial reports, and existing reconciliation schedules connecting accounting records to published totals.
